title: Finite-time blowup of the IPM equation from smooth initial data without forcing
summary: We prove finite-time gradient blow-up for the unforced incompressible porous media equation on the two-dimensional torus, removing the forcing used in the IPM blow-up constructions of Alpöge, Buckmaster, and Coiculescu \cite{lit:ABC} and Córdoba and Martínez-Zoroa \cite{lit:CMIPM}. The key is an identity that expresses the logarithmic growth of a layer's gradient as the negative pressure curvature transverse to its transported phase.
